commit_message:
[VectorExt] Reject reshapes that reorder nested layout levels

When merging source dimensions, reshape can consume an element level
after a thread level and change which elements each thread owns.
Track the last level consumed for each target dimension and reject
reshapes that would reorder non-unit levels.

Add tests for forward and backward layout propagation, plus a valid
reshape where each thread's elements remain contiguous.

Fixes #24955

[Build] Stop CMake riscv64 defaults from clobbering test cpu-features (#24866)

platform cmake defaults were appending
--iree-llvmcpu-target-cpu-features= after test variants, so the default
overwrote +xsmtvdot / VLEN. this prevents the override of an existing
cpu-features flag; prepend missing +m,+a,+f,+d,+c. and strips those from
generator --requirements=.
